title: Campaign and channel planning
description: An audience-led campaign brief, channel choice and evaluation plan.

sources.title: UK Government Communication Service, Campaign lifecycle

rules.instruction: Define the audience behavior or decision the campaign should change. Record the current baseline, evidence about that audience and a success measure before approval.
rules.verification: Have the campaign owner identify the source for the baseline and explain which measurement would justify continuing the campaign.

rules.instruction: Compare channels on the audience reached, expected action, production effort and measurement limits. State the evidence behind each choice and what a small trial could disprove.
rules.verification: Check that the plan gives each selected channel a role in the campaign and includes a pilot whose result could change the plan.

rules.instruction: After launch, review spend and observed outcomes against the planned baseline. Document major overlaps or audience changes that limit attribution.
rules.verification: Reconcile reported outcomes with the agreed data source and record the owner's decision to keep, adjust or stop each action.
